name: @lfb/backend
//node_options: The heap ceiling is a DECISION, never V8's accidental default (memory.mdx P-31/P-32 + invariant 4).
The flags, and the whole derivation of the 6144MB number, now live in ../../../scripts/node-heap-run.mjs
— read the header there before changing either.
WHY A WRAPPER SCRIPT: inline `VAR=... cmd` is POSIX-sh syntax. cmd.exe and PowerShell read it as a
program name, so `pnpm dev` failed outright on Windows and the backend never started. The wrapper sets
the same NODE_OPTIONS the same way — ours first, the caller's appended after, so a user-supplied
--max-old-space-size still wins — and works on all three platforms.
